blocks.text: God’s Family Church is a local church based in Buena Park, California. Our English-Speaking Congregation (ESC) is divided into multiple house churches based on age groups: Catalyst (our youth house church), college, and young adults/married couples.

Our mission statement is based on the Great Commission given to the Church in Matthew 28. Therefore, we purpose to reach our communities for Christ and build them up as fully devoted servant-leaders so that they can be sent out as messengers of the Good News. We exist to know God and make Him known.
Location: 6551 Western Ave., Buena Park, CA 90621

Tim Yu serves as the head pastor and the English-Speaking Congregation’s director here at God’s Family Church. He graduated from UCLA with a degree in psychobiology and from Fuller Theological Seminary, where he received his master’s degree in theology and a doctoral degree in clinical psychology. He is married to his wife, Paulina, with whom he has a daughter named Samantha. In addition to his love for ministry, he is passionate about basketball, movies, and photography.

We here at God’s Family Church believe that house church is the heart and core value of ministry that aims to imitate and restore the New Testament church. A house church is a community comprised of 6-12 members that fulfills all the intrinsic purposes of church (worship, education, fellowship, service, evangelism, missions), shepherded by lay leaders.

Every Wednesdays and Fridays, all of GFC’s house churches meet in each member’s homes to come and break bread, praise, share about their lives, and pray together while providing a space for our non-believing VIPs to come to know and believe in Christ. Our church’s purpose is to save the lost and make disciples that make disciples, and we believe that house church ministry allows for that to happen.

If you are new and interested in joining a house church, please let any of our members know and we will be more than happy to plug you into any of our house churches! If you have any questions or concerns, please email us at gfchousechurches@gmail.com.
